description:
Beasts of the Big Blue is a cinematic underwater wildlife series packed with action and spectacle. Each episode includes drama, comedy, and fascinating animal behaviour. Every episode introduces a unique marine “neighbourhood” and a cast of aquatic characters from gigantic whales to tiny paper nautilus. There are popular superstars and unsung heroes. The animal stories spring from their unique locations in the Pacific, from the tropics to near-Antarctic seas. Weird, wonderful, and sometimes never before seen behaviour will be revealed in these wild and remote places that have been hidden from view from all but the most intrepid.
- Love Nature
